description: MerLin photonic adaptation (reduced-scope validation): PA (phase sandwich, m=n modes) and PB (bosonic hopping chain, m=n+1 modes), k=floor(m/2) photons, threshold detection, exact FOCK simulation; n=4-14, 10 seeds, all study components, paper grids, paper + 5-fold CV (CV at n=4,8,12). Photonic FQK up to 14 modes.
